chunks: By this chain of narrators, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan al-Ashqar, from Salih ibn Abi al-Aswad, from his brother, from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them all), who said:

Whenever a revelation came down to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) during the day, he would not sleep until he had informed Ali of it. And whenever it came down to him at night, he would not greet the morning until he had informed Ali of it.

key_terms.الوحي: Divine revelation, the inspired word of God transmitted to the Prophet through the angel Jibril (Gabriel)
key_terms.يصبح: To enter the morning, to greet the dawn; here meaning the Prophet would not let morning come without informing Ali
key_terms.يمس: To sleep/rest (lit. 'to touch the ground at night'); here meaning the Prophet would not retire to sleep

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad inform Ali of every revelation he received?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates through a chain ascending to Imam al-Hasan (AS) that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) had an unwavering practice: every divine revelation he received was immediately shared with Imam Ali (AS), whether it arrived during the day or the night. This tradition underscores the intimate spiritual and intellectual partnership between the Prophet and Ali, affirming Ali's unique status as the immediate recipient of all prophetic knowledge from divine revelation. In the Shia understanding, this practice reflects the doctrine of the Imamate — that Ali was designated as the guardian and transmitter of divine guidance after the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from al-Husayn b. al-Hasan al-Ashqar from Salih b. Abi’l Aswad from his brother from `Abdullah b. al-Hasan b. al-Hasan b. `Ali from his father from his grandfather (as). He said:

Whenever a revelation would come down to the Prophet (s) during the day, he would not sleep until he informed `Ali of it. When it would come down to him during the night, he would not awake [for the morning] until he informed `Ali of it.
